record.interface_detail: a browser IDE and a hosted app preview on the free Starter plan; SSH with an account-level public key, usable from a local editor, on Core, Pro and other paid plans only
record.tooling: the Replit IDE, Nix-based environments, a shell in the browser
record.chaining: 30 days of a preview URL, then nothing

limits.value: 1 published app, taken down after 30 days

record.limits_note: compute is metered on paid tiers; the free tier is a preview
record.reliability_note: the free published link is taken down after 30 days, so anything served from it has a dated death
record.notes: https://replit.com/pricing returned 403 with a 2026-10-21 snapshot and lists only Core, Pro and Enterprise, so no free price could be read there. The Starter limits come from the docs. GPU class, RAM and hours are unpublished.

free_tier.stated: Starter is free: daily Agent credits up to a monthly cap, monthly cloud-usage credits, one published app whose link goes down after 30 days, and Lite build only; no compute hours, RAM or session length are published
free_tier.notes: The free plan is denominated in credits and app count, never in machine time.

retention.stated: the one free published app's link 'will automatically go down after 30 days'

egress.terms: Outbound data transfer from published deployments is priced at USD 0.05 per GiB from 2026-08-01 (USD 0.10 before); no free allowance is stated on the page

identity_cost.detail: a Replit account; the Starter plan states no card

extras.unattended_mechanism: unverified: deployments exist but the free plan gets one app that is removed after 30 days
extras.units: RAM and disk are quoted in the vendor's own decimal GB, not GiB. The ram_gib and disk_gib keys carry the vendor's number unconverted, so where a vendor writes 30 GB the key holds 30 and the true value is about 27.9 GiB. No conversion was performed.

record.confidence_note: The pricing page itself returned 403 with a cached snapshot, so no price was read from it.
record.binding_note: there is no published compute allowance at all, so the free plan cannot be budgeted for a job

card.summary: No free storage allowance. App Storage is metered: $0.015/GiB/mo storage, $0.05/GiB data transfer, $0.0004/1k basic ops.

free_tier.stated: No free storage allowance. App Storage is metered: $0.015/GiB/mo storage, $0.05/GiB data transfer, $0.0004/1k basic ops.

egress.terms: 'App Storage Data Transfer: $0.05 per GiB'. Plain metered egress, no free allowance.

record.tooling: S3-shaped API on top of GCS (buckets, access policies); usable with standard S3 tooling.
record.chaining: None. Metered storage plus metered egress means multiplying accounts multiplies the bill, not the capacity.
record.limits_note: 7-day minimum billing period per object; Starter plan gets 1 published app whose link 'will automatically go down after 30 days'; per-account storage limits are 'determined by plan' and not published as a number.
record.reliability_note: Backed by Google Cloud Storage with metered rates for storage and egress. No perpetual free storage tier is provided.
